# 胡智勇 John Hu (hutusi)

> 胡智勇（John Hu，网名 hutusi）的个人主页：一张中英双语名片。John Hu's homepage: a bilingual calling card.

## 中文

胡智勇（John Hu，网名 hutusi），开发者、写作者。在博客「胡涂说」记录技术与思考，编辑《好奇心周刊》，并用 AI 打造一系列小而美的软件作品（ainaive.com）。

- [博客「胡涂说」](https://hutusi.com)
- [好奇心周刊](https://hutusi.substack.com/)
- [作品 ainaive.com](https://ainaive.com)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/hutusi)
- [X](https://x.com/hutusi)
- 微信公众号：胡涂说（微信搜 hututalk）
- 邮箱：[me@hutu.si](mailto:me@hutu.si)

## English

John Hu (胡智勇, known online as hutusi) is a developer and writer. He writes the blog 胡涂说 at hutusi.com, edits the Curiosity Weekly newsletter, and builds small, AI-powered software, collected at ainaive.com.

- [Blog: 胡涂说](https://hutusi.com)
- [Newsletter: Curiosity Weekly (好奇心周刊)](https://hutusi.substack.com/)
- [Projects: ainaive.com](https://ainaive.com)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/hutusi)
- [X](https://x.com/hutusi)
